description: Opt-out fer Radaris (radaris.com). Fills the name search automatically, then hands the listing pick an' confirmation to a sailor.
steps.7.text: Radaris needs ye to finish this one. Go to radaris.com/control-privacy, search fer {full_name} an' yer city, click, matey, yer own profile, then smash the blue "Start Removing" button. Enter {contact_email} as the email address an' submit. Radaris emails a link to that address; OpenOptOut clicks it fer ye.
